thesis: Short-term momentum improved above SMA-20/50, but price remains below SMA-200 with negative 60/252-bar returns; dated headlines do not verify a sustained earnings recovery.
strongest_counterexample: The strongest counterexample is durable EU demand and commercial-truck adoption converting the recent headlines into profitable growth, which is not shown in the supplied data.
invalidation_conditions: A close below the observed 20-bar low would weaken the short-term recovery case.
evidence_gaps: Financial statement dates and current earnings trajectory are missing.
Headlines do not quantify repeatability or margin impact.
decisive_factors: Positive 5/20-bar returns and MACD conflict with negative 60/252-bar returns.
